# Generating an LCM image and perform Alchemy Upscale

```shell Shell
curl --request POST \
     --url https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/generations-lcm \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header 'authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>' \
     --header 'content-type: application/json' \
     --data '
{
  "width": 512,
  "height": 512,
  "imageDataUrl": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "prompt": "a girl in a red dress with yellow belt",
  "guidance": 5,
  "strength": 0.81,
  "style": "ANIME",
  "steps": 10
}
'

# Note the imageDataUrl in the response

curl --request POST \
     --url https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/generations-lcm \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header 'authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>' \
     --header 'content-type: application/json' \
     --data '
{
  "width": 512,
  "height": 512,
  "imageDataUrl": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "prompt": "girl in red dress with yellow belt in a ballroom",
  "guidance": 3,
  "style": "ANIME",
  "refineCreative": true,
  "steps": 12,
  "strength": 0.7
}
'

```

```json Response Example
{

  }

```

# Generate with base64 image



This command creates an LCM generation with an example body.

To use this command, first replace <YOUR_API_KEY> with your API key. Then, run it in your terminal.

Note the imageDataUrl needs to be a base64 Image String and in .jpeg format only.

Strength refers to Creativity strength. The higher it is, the more creative the LCM generation gets from your input image. The lower it is, the more similar it will be to your input image.

Keep note of the imageDataUrl in the response for the next step.

# Apply Alchemy upscale to LCM image

<!-- shell@21-38 -->

To apply Alchemy, replace the imageDataUrl with the imageDataUrl that returned in the previous call.

Note that guidance will refer to how closely the output will follow the prompt. The higher it is, the closer it will follow the prompt. 

The response will include the Upscaled image in the imageDataUrl.
